title: CateKV: On Sequential Consistency for Long-Context LLM Inference Acceleration
abstract: arXiv:2608.30295v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in handling long-context tasks, but processing such long contexts remains challenging due to the substantial memory requirements and inference latency. In this work, we discover that certain attention heads exhibit sequential consistency in their attention patterns, which can be persistently identified using a coefficient-of-variation-based algorithm. Inspired by this observation, we propose CateKV, a hybrid KV cache method that retains only critical token information for consistent heads, thereby reducing KV cache size and computational overhead, while preserving the majority of KV pairs in adaptive heads to ensure high accuracy. We show the unique characteristics of our algorithm and its extension with existing acceleration methods. translated_title: CateKV：面向长上下文大语言模型推理加速的顺序一致性研究
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在处理长上下文任务方面展现出强大的能力，但由于巨大的内存需求和推理延迟，处理如此长的上下文仍然具有挑战性。在本工作中，我们发现某些注意力头在其注意力模式中表现出顺序一致性，并且可以通过基于变异系数的算法持续地识别出来。受这一观察的启发，我们提出了CateKV，这是一种混合KV缓存方法，它仅为一致性注意力头保留关键的token信息，从而减少KV缓存大小和计算开销，同时在自适应注意力头中保留大部分KV对以确保高准确率。我们展示了该算法的独特特性及其与现有加速方法的结合扩展。在长上下文基准测试上的全面评估表明，在保持与全注意力机制相当的准确率的同时，CateKV降低了……
tldr: CateKV发现部分注意力头的注意力模式具有可用变异系数算法稳定识别的顺序一致性，据此提出混合KV缓存方法，仅为一致性注意力头保留关键token信息，从而在保持精度的同时显著降低KV缓存大小与计算开销，加速长上下文LLM推理。
en_tdlr: CateKV discovers that certain attention heads exhibit sequentially consistent attention patterns identifiable via a coefficient-of-variation-based algorithm, and proposes a hybrid KV cache method that retains only critical tokens for consistent heads, reducing KV cache size and computational overhead while maintaining accuracy for long-context LLM inference.
